_scenario_name: Avalon UK — London-incorporated, Indian engineer, EMI option
_narrative: Avalon Labs Ltd is a London-incorporated AI startup, < 250 employees, qualifies for EMI. Their data-platform lead is based in Pune (India). The grant was issued under the EMI scheme (Schedule 5 ITEPA 2003) but the employee never worked in the UK — so EMI status is moot from the Indian-resident perspective. She exercises 5,000 options at £0.20 strike with FMV £1.50 on 1 May 2026. The cross-border edge case: UK-resident grantor + Indian-resident employee with no UK workdays.
